title: Which Limit Binds the Courtesy Credit on Savings and Money Market Accounts
content:
Which limit binds the courtesy credit on an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts follows the withdrawal history of the account: the count of withdrawals posted to it in the twelve calendar months ending on the review date.

Where 5 or more withdrawals posted in that window, only the allowance amount binds the rounded courtesy credit, and the courtesy ceiling does not bind at all.

Where 3 or 4 withdrawals posted in that window, only the courtesy ceiling of 24.00 USD binds it, and the allowance amount does not.

Where fewer than 3 withdrawals posted in that window, the credit booked is the lesser of the rounded courtesy credit, the allowance amount and the courtesy ceiling, so both limits bind and the smaller of the two governs.

### A worked case on hypothetical inputs

Take a rounded courtesy credit of 30.00 USD against an allowance amount of 16.00 USD. With 6 withdrawals in the window the credit booked is 16.00 USD; with 3 withdrawals it is 24.00 USD; with 1 withdrawal both limits bind, the lesser of 16.00 USD and 24.00 USD governs, and the credit booked is again 16.00 USD.

Take instead a rounded courtesy credit of 10.00 USD against the same allowance amount of 16.00 USD. In every band the rounded credit already stands below what binds it, so the credit booked is 10.00 USD throughout.

A count of exactly 5 withdrawals falls in the first band, a count of exactly 3 in the second, and a count of 2, 1 or 0 in the third.
